_comment: Each painting needs: file, title, size, medium, year, description. Size accepts inches (e.g. '12x16in') or centimeters (e.g. '30x40cm'). Width × height. You can mix units across paintings.

paintings.title: Strands
paintings.description: A conceptual geometric landscape. The largest piece in the current collection.

paintings.title: Salt Flats
paintings.description: A conceptual landscape of geometric salt pans, a bright triangular road converging toward the horizon. The palette reduced to warm earth and bone.

paintings.title: Framework
paintings.description: An abstract architecture of beams and uprights — a study of the structure that holds space, the A-frame rising out of a nest of timber.

paintings.title: Coastal Strata
paintings.description: Layered ridges resolving into bands of violet, teal, and ochre. An elevated view where the land reads almost as wave-forms, each strata catching its own light.

paintings.title: Bolsa Chica
paintings.description: Looking down through a gap in the coastal rocks to the wetlands beyond, with the distant mountains dissolving into a pale gray sky. Braided channels of water and marsh grass spread out to the horizon.

paintings.title: Structure Study
paintings.description: A semi-abstract investigation of overhead architecture — beams, light, and the geometry of a constructed space resolving into planes of color.

paintings.title: Hillside in Blue
paintings.description: Rolling hills resolved into bands of teal, ochre and shadow. The sea sits low on the horizon, cool against the warm broken color of the foreground.

paintings.title: Coastal Headland
paintings.description: A windswept ridge falling away to a pale, cool sea. Painted on location, working quickly to catch the shifting afternoon light on the cliff face.

paintings.title: Valley Lights
paintings.description: A broad valley at dusk, dotted with the first lights of evening. The mountainside in the foreground holds onto the day's last warmth.

paintings.title: Evening Grassland
paintings.description: Golden grass raked by late afternoon light, the far hills holding the last of the day's cool blues. Heavy impasto in the foreground grasses.

paintings.title: Rolling Hills
paintings.description: Rolling California hills in late spring, the dry grass catching warm light while the far ridges go cool. Signed lower right.

paintings.title: Silver Morning
paintings.description: A soft overcast morning — the sky done in long horizontal strokes, the foreground hills a textured tangle of ochre and violet.

paintings.title: Botchers Gap, Dusk
paintings.description: A small plein air study from the same vantage as Botchers Gap, painted later in the day. Moody, almost monochrome — the hills falling into deep shadow with only a thin band of sky still lit.

paintings.title: Botchers Gap
paintings.description: Looking through a wooden fence at sunset light catching the far ridges. A small framed study from a high overlook.

paintings.title: Arch Beach Heights
paintings.description: A quiet Laguna morning from the heights — pale silhouettes of distant ranges above a patchwork of fields and light.

paintings.title: Studio Window
paintings.description: Looking out through the cross-bars of a window at a distant ribbon of sea. The window itself becomes part of the composition — a quiet, abstracted framing.

paintings.title: Desert Wash
paintings.description: High desert in late spring — pale earth, scattered sage, and the long pink shadows of an afternoon coming to a close.

paintings.title: Form
paintings.description: A small conceptual study — a tideline at dawn or dusk, the wet sand inlaid with glass marbles catching the last light.
